title: Interior angles of polygons
goal: I can find the sum of the interior angles of a polygon and each angle of a regular polygon.
teach: From one vertex, draw diagonals to split a polygon with n sides into n − 2 triangles. So the interior angles add up to (n − 2) × 180°. In a regular polygon all angles are equal: each angle = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n.

ex.q: Find each interior angle of a regular hexagon.
steps: A regular hexagon has 6 equal angles.

watch:
It is (n − 2) × 180°, not n × 180°.

Problem-solving lens
Split the shape into triangles. You already know a triangle’s angle sum.

qs.text: Find the angle sum of a hexagon.
qs.steps:
1. Formula: sum of the interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°, where n is the number of sides.
2. sum of the interior angles = (6 − 2) × 180°
3. = 4 × 180° = 720°

qs.text: Find the angle sum of an octagon.
qs.steps:
1. Formula: sum of the interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°, where n is the number of sides.
2. sum of the interior angles = (8 − 2) × 180°
3. = 6 × 180° = 1 080°

qs.text: Find each interior angle of a regular hexagon.
qs.steps:
1. Formula: each interior angle of a regular polygon = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n
2. (6 − 2) × 180° ÷ 6
3. = 720° ÷ 6 = 120°
